title: Loop Video – Repeat a Clip Online Free, No Upload
description: Repeat a video 2 to 20 times, or until it lasts the number of seconds you choose, in your browser. Sound included and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Loop a Video
subtitle: Play a clip several times in a row, or until it reaches the length you need, and save it as one video.
intro: Make a short clip long enough for a background, a status, a shop screen or a presentation. Choose how many times it plays, or type the length you need in seconds and the page works out the repeats and cuts the last one to fit exactly.

features.title: Private
features.text: The loop is made by your own browser; your video never leaves your device.

features.title: Exact length
features.text: Ask for 30 seconds and get 30 seconds: the last repeat is cut to fit.

features.title: Sound included
features.text: The clip’s sound repeats with its picture.

steps.title: Choose a video
steps.text: Pick a clip or drop it on the page.

steps.title: Set the loop
steps.text: Choose 2 to 20 repeats, or the length you want in seconds.

steps.title: Loop and download
steps.text: Click Loop video, check the result and download it.

handles: Repeats: 2 to 20, or as many as a length of up to 10 minutes needs.
Formats: MP4, WebM, MOV and MKV keep their format; other videos become MP4.
Picture: the same size and frame rate as your clip.
limits: A looped video is at most 10 minutes long.
The video is encoded again, which takes a moment for long loops.
There is no fade between repeats; each one starts straight after the last.

faq.question: Is my video uploaded?
faq.answer: No. The looping is done by your own browser, on your device, with the video encoders built into it. Nothing is sent to a server; open your browser's network panel while it runs and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I make a video exactly 60 seconds long?
faq.answer: Choose “Until it lasts”, type 60 and click Loop video. The clip repeats as often as needed and the last repeat stops at 60 seconds.

faq.question: Can I loop a video for Instagram or WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Yes. Loop it to the length you need, then download the MP4, which both apps accept.

faq.question: Is there a length limit?
faq.answer: The result can be up to 10 minutes long, and very large videos are limited by your device’s memory.

faq.question: Does the sound loop too?
faq.answer: Yes, the sound repeats with the picture each time.

faq.question: Is it free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.

faq.question: Does looping lower the quality?
faq.answer: The loop is encoded again at a high quality, at your clip's size and frame rate, so each repeat looks very close to the original.
